title: Principal Relationship Status
description: State of the seller's commercial relationship with the authenticated caller, as get_principal reports it in relationship.status.

enumDescriptions.pending_approval: The seller is reviewing an application or approval for this caller. The same value and meaning as enums/account-status.json pending_approval, which the same human sees on sync_accounts. setup, when present, carries the caller's next step.
enumDescriptions.active: The relationship is in good standing.
enumDescriptions.suspended: The relationship is temporarily paused; calls that need it fail with AGENT_SUSPENDED.
enumDescriptions.blocked: The relationship is permanently denied; calls that need it fail with AGENT_BLOCKED.
